description: Use this when the user needs to upload one or two image files (PNG/JPG/JPEG, max 10MB each) for Freebeat workflows. Use returned image_urls with generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video for song-driven videos, or pass a single uploaded image URL to generate_effect.reference_image_urls to replace the default list_effects.image_url. Does not generate or edit images.

file_paths.description: Local image file paths to upload. Provide 1 to 2 image files. Not available on the hosted server.

files.description: One or two image attachments supplied by ChatGPT.

urls.description: Public HTTPS urls of PNG/JPG images to upload, 1 to 2, max 10MB each.

name: upload_image

image_urls.description: The uploaded image URLs returned by Freebeat.

items.description: A static URL for an uploaded image.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the upload result.

success.description: Whether the image upload completed successfully.
